name: Senoo Kazumi
source:
He loves very much [url=https://vndb.org/c11762]Tsugumi[/url], his younger sister and [url=https://vndb.org/c11764]Shizuka[/url], his childhood friend ( not in a romantically way for his sister ).

[spoiler]He is apparently into cuckolding, enjoying hearing his little sister experiences. But he feels frustrated when his sister or childhood friend have sex with someone else in front of him.

He had a secret crush in his youth on Shizuka but he always thought he wasn't good enough for her and he's been trying since to forget his feelings for her.
[/spoiler]
